journeys.goal: A new reader signs up, logs in, adds a book and puts it on their shelf
journeys.why_included: Covers the sign-up and login routes and the authenticated routes that check the token on every request

journeys.goal: A reader logs in, reviews a book and reads the reviews
journeys.why_included: Authenticated write followed by a public read of the same data

journeys.goal: A visitor browses books by tag and opens one
journeys.why_included: Public routes only; they share the store with the changed code but never check a token

journeys.goal: A reader views their shelf and removes a book
journeys.why_included: Authenticated list and delete routes on the shelf
